scripts.dev: npm run build:server && { npm run serve & S=$!; trap 'kill $S' EXIT; npm run dev:app; }
scripts.dev:android: npm run build:server && { npm run serve & S=$!; trap 'kill $S' EXIT; npm --prefix app run tauri android dev; }
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:server && npm run serve
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:app
scripts.build:android: npm --prefix app run tauri android build -- --apk --debug --target aarch64
scripts.test: (cd core && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test) && (cd server && go vet ./... && go test ./...) && npm --prefix app run build
